final_claim: Accelerated filtrations break arbitrary-filtration entropy-growth implications

correctness.rationale: For any finite frame U containing 1, the exponential reindexing V_n=U^{b^n} is a valid finite-dimensional filtration because b^n+b^m<=b^{n+m}. Infinite dimensionality makes every adjacent power strict, yielding entropy at least log b. For k[x] the quotient dimensions are exactly (b-1)b^{n-1}, so entropy is log b while GK dimension is 1. The one-sided comparison and linear-control repair follow from U^n subset V_{sn}, the reverse linear inclusion, and subadditivity of log dim U^n.
